name: Piglin Paintings
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: SuperWarioModTeam
description: Adds a collection of Piglin themed paintings inspired by both vanilla and MC Dungeons.
works: Data only: 15 Piglin-themed painting variants (piglin_paintings:piglin, brute, hoglin, ...) added to the placeable paintings tag, so they appear when a painting is hung.
note: From Modrinth, unchanged (with its data from Horizon's mod browser). Not yet: its painting textures are the mod's own assets, shown only with Horizon's import of its data; the mod works without it
